findings.baseline_vs_checkpoint_braking_phase: Both begin sustained rotor braking5.28s and sustained net braking5.34s; max horizontal speed falls only3.5493→3.5329m/s; finite peak falls.78663→.76961m. The critical braking phase is essentially unchanged after1M.
findings.why_corner_guard_can_pass: The .7696m deviation is before goal3 confirmation7.10s. Its post-confirmation outgoing corner window peaks only.07802m; the global finite-segment peak correctly retains the pre-confirmation incoming overshoot.
findings.reviewable_next_test: A future separately authorized intervention should isolate wind assisting versus opposing the incoming leg at fixed initial state/yaw, and assess sphere-entry speed/braking timing. No such rollout is performed here.

interpretation.evidence: Seed84001 receives a westward force .46s after activating westbound descending leg3. The same actor/initial-state nominal trajectory is exactly identical until force onset and remains below .25m peak. Wind strong/gust are identical until gust-off7.76, so the duplicate peak reflects a common first pulse. Peak is axial endpoint overshoot before successful arrival confirmation, with essentially zero vertical goal error.
interpretation.causal_hypothesis: Along-track force accelerates an already fast westbound approach; the policy brakes but does not remove the extra incoming momentum before crossing the goal sphere. Dwell resets delay confirmation until recovery. This is supported by recorded force/velocity/action/acceleration timing, not by a new flight counterfactual.
interpretation.not_established: Four seeds jointly vary weather direction/timing and initial yaw/position. Existing traces do not isolate their interaction independently; no claim that yaw is irrelevant. No matched comparison with Gazebo seed83301 is made, and the different weather case is not evidence of a rate-fit failure.
interpretation.next_iteration_basis: Target diagnosis/evaluation of wind-assisted incoming-leg braking and too-fast sphere entry. Native shaper, collective mapping, reward and actor sources remain frozen during this audit.
